summary.text: Linda Serrato is a Democratic state representative from District 45 who has represented the district since October 2020 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She chairs the Local Government, Land Grants and Cultural Affairs Committee and previously ran a communications firm.

paragraphs.text: Linda Serrato earned a bachelor's degree in public policy from Stanford University in 2007.
Before taking office she was CEO of SerratoYbarra Communications, and she worked for Congressman Ben Ray Luján from 2017 to 2019.
Serrato took office on October 17, 2020, succeeding Jim Trujillo.
For 2025-2026 she chairs the Local Government, Land Grants and Cultural Affairs Committee, and in 2023-2024 she was vice chair of the Commerce and Economic Development Committee.
